theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure is the top-ranked theme (score 2.14, rank 1, eligible via absolute-trend gate) with broad participation (breadth 0.917) and is neither crowded (z 0.78) nor a one-narrative concentration. theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity ranks 2 with the highest trend coherence (hurst 'trend', durability 0.84, breadth 1.0) and is the rotation challenger. Its crowded flag (z 1.88) is treated strictly as a sizing caution, not a fade, per guardrails. The trend-gate eligibility and full breadth support a modest overweight over the leader on relative trend strength.
theses.dissent: The theme is the most crowded in the top decile; crowding marks attention tops historically and the challenger margin to the leader is wide (0.692), so it may not convert to leadership.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: US Energy Complex is the top-scoring non-AI diversifier (rank 6) with an intact absolute-trend gate (eligible true) and a 'trend' hurst tag at low crowding (z 0.63). Its narrower breadth (0.455) keeps conviction low, but it offers non-correlated trend exposure absent from the AI cluster.
